ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Tender and estimate, Estimating and later stages need Site visit done and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Tender_estimate", CASE(StageName, "Opportunity", 1, "Go or no-go", 2, "Estimating", 3, "Bid submitted", 4, "Clarification", 5, "Preferred bidder", 6, "Awarded", 7, 0) >= 3, OR(NOT(Site_visit_done__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Site visit done and Next step date before moving to Estimating.
